incidents.issue: The operating system rejected hidden-client replacement on read-only staged files. The operator restored owner-write permission without changing source bytes or restarting participants. Elapsed times include the interruption. Subsequent held-out initial templates had mutable and hidden-overlay targets made owner-writable before dispatch. Both h1 sessions were stopped when review found the prompt required retaining the first active move while a hidden client explicitly required replacing it on successive direct calls. No replacement sessions were run. The new task prompt corrects this conflict for future campaigns.

interpretation: Each result measures one fresh session on the named task. Dispatch and host conditions can vary. Finite independent clients establish behavior on their test inputs. Raw receipts stay local; patches are relative to each task's initial snapshot.
limitations: Advisory blindness and fresh-chat operator attestation; model actions outside wrapper and token counts unknown. Times are operator wall elapsed, not native performance.

native_cost.metric: same-host wall milliseconds from CLI launch through exit, alternating old/new order
